case_name: Smt. Sudama Devi vs Smt. Malti Devi & Anr.

parties.respondent_defendant: Smt. Malti Devi & Anr. (first wife and widow of the deceased)

facts_of_case: Petitioner filed a petition under Section 372 of the Indian Succession Act for grant of Succession Certificate in respect of debts and securities of her deceased husband-Ram Narain. Objections were filed by Malti Devi who claimed herself to be the first wife and widow of the deceased.

legal_principles.principle: The documentary evidence led and appreciated by the two courts below does not suffer from any infirmity.
legal_principles.held: Evidence led before the two courts below has been weighed rightly in the scale of balance and both the two fact finding courts in fact have correctly held that it was Malti Devi who was the wife and widow of Ram Narain;

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant party to show that in spite of due diligence, the said documents could not be produced.
legal_principles.held: there is not a single whisper of this in the present application which has been filed under Section 151 of the Code;

outcome.final_order: The order impugned before this court is the order dated 22.04.2004 which had endorsed the finding of the Civil Judge dated 22.10.2001 in proceedings under Section 372 of the Indian Succession Act.
